skill.summary: Book air cargo flights, freight shipping and parcel air transport with oversized luggage booking. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tic...

latestVersion.changelog:
cargo-flight 3.2.0 — Major compliance and workflow enforcement update

- Enforces strict data provenance: answers only from flyai CLI output, never from training data.
- Mandates CLI environment and installation checks before any execution.
- Specifies single-command execution workflows for all core scenarios.
- Requires that every result includes a `[Book]({detailUrl})` link for booking.
- Provides new detailed usage/playbook guides and stricter output formatting rules.
- Expands supported commands with new parameter mapping for specific freight and cargo queries.
